verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Chargebacks API that lets you retrieve chargeback details, and test mode can simulate chargebacks. That covers only the retrieval step of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows an API for submitting dispute evidence or a response, and the Mollie MCP server's documented API list does not include Chargebacks. Missing for 10: an API endpoint to upload or assemble dispute evidence, an API to submit or contest a chargeback response, Chargebacks coverage in the MCP server, and any hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven dispute workflow.
